scope: Authored room slug, online projection, member nickname, and realm moderation HTTP continuation. Owned DTOs remain explicitly versioned; excluded Shared/SDK/protocol/generated implementation was not used.
boundaries: Nick is the only authored member-profile request field. No invented member media associations or arbitrary URLs; returned account comes from the current canonical account projection.
Anonymous public slug lookup requires plaintext public room and current scope visibility; inaccessible targets return uniform 404. Exact legacy private-room disclosure is intentionally not preserved.
Slug scope is account name first, then realm slug, with live lookups and transactional unique constraints. No cached alias survives room/account/realm rename.

Current paid internal system subscriptions require explicit identifier-to-level policy and level >=2. Missing configuration returns 503; no default subscription grant or tier exists. Profile clear needs authenticated membership, not a paid entitlement or manage scope.

Online membership reuses the owned canonical presence projection, including bilateral blocks, privacy, invisibility, session lease/epoch/version, and disable punishment checks. No socket or remote status call is added.

Moderation aliases require existing global scopes, current realm chat moderation and chat membership, no active actor timeout, and target role hierarchy. The unencrypted message deletion retains sync tombstones, removes old snapshots/reactions/media associations, and records reason without retaining deleted content in audit.
Legacy provider push notification side effects and excluded full legacy DTO equivalence remain unclaimed; no provider calls are introduced.
